related.description: Zsh completion plugin for the LLM CLI tool by Simon Willison
Zsh plugin to generate shell commands from natural language using local LLMs via ollama
Tiny Zsh plugin that opens a prompt, asks an LLM for shell command suggestions, and lets you pick one and execute it.
A no-bullshit, seamless way to use LLMs right inside your shell. Supports bash and zsh
